headline: Holland America Line Unveils Bar 1873, a Stunning Venue Inspired by More Than 150 Years of Maritime Heritage
summary: Holland America Line is introducing Bar 1873, a new signature gathering place where contemporary design, cocktails and live music bring more than 150 years of the cruise line's history to life. Debuting aboard Oosterdam as part of the ship's Holland America Evolution transformation, the two-story atrium venue will feature a soaring illuminated tulip sculpture, curated heritage displays and comfortable lounges designed for cocktails, conversation and intimate entertainment.
